copy: Good decisions are judged by how they were made, then by what happened.

archetypes.MEDIATOR: You made both teams see the same facts and built what they could both sign.
archetypes.DECIDER: You picked a side when it mattered and still brought the whole team across the line.
archetypes.SHOWRUNNER: You went for the spectacle and paid for it in supervision.
archetypes.GAMBLER: You bet on speed and the room cracked.
archetypes.BYSTANDER: You kept the peace and shipped nothing. Politeness is not a plan.
archetypes.PRAGMATIST: You took the steady path and the results were steady.
